name: Dura-Ace shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed weight for the complete left/right ST-R9120 hydraulic-disc dual-control lever pair: 505 g. The 2017 Shimano trade manual explicitly labels this as a pair weight; it is not a sum of separate controls or a complete caliper/hose/brake-system weight.
